bundle_rationale:
Operational work in isolation: CI/CD, infrastructure, observability,
rollout controls, secrets, and platform hygiene are the deliverable.
Use when the user is not redesigning product UI or backend contracts,
but does need explicit operational architecture and execution planning.

needs.evidence: The objective implements the CD-4 ADR-defined adapter and requires an implementation plan unless that ADR is a frozen specification.
The work adds an OpenAPI adapter that connects Git baseline retrieval, a pinned external tool, diagnostics, and shared Dogwatch finding contracts.
The implementation spans validation, safe tool execution, normalization, provenance, and a fixture-matrix test suite.
The objective explicitly requests implementation and deterministic automated coverage in the existing codebase.
Developer changes must be checked against the stated safety and acceptance criteria.

dropped.evidence: CD-4 already completed the relevant safe OpenAPI adapter research/ADR, and CD-9 asks to implement that defined adapter rather than investigate an unresolved question.
The ticket contains no screen, user flow, or visual-behavior criterion; it specifies a backend OpenAPI adapter and automated tests.
